text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After class, I spot Eishin Flash and Daiwa Scarlet in front of the school building. They seem perturbed.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Nooo… It looks like it's about to rain any second, Flash.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: This is concerning. If we go looking for umbrellas now, we'll be late by more than five minutes.
choice_data_list: You can use this umbrella if you like.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I appreciate your generous offer… but won't you get soaked by the rain instead?
choice_data_list: I've got a folding umbrella with me too.
I've got a folding umbrella with me too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Then I suppose I have no reason to refuse. Thank you for this.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: If you're free, would you like to come along and watch the tryouts with us?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes. I have an important matter scheduled for today. Come, let's go to the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh no! It started raining!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Move in closer, Scarlet. Otherwise your shoulder will get wet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh, um… Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Sharing an umbrella like this feels a little embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Scarlet, your shoulder is still protruding beyond the umbrella by three centimeters. Please come closer to me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: O-okay… Ahaha… Is it hot today or is it just me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of them draw close under the umbrella and begin stepping in unison.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: The rain has eased up. Thank goodness it was only a passing shower.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah! The race is about to start, Flash!
choice_data_list: So, what was that important matter you mentioned?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: One of the younger students that Scarlet and I have grown close to is competing in today's tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: She's quite dear to us, so we came to support her.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I wonder if she'll be okay… Do you think she's nervous?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: The only thing we can do at this point is cheer her on. Let's have faith in her.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah! This is it! Do your best out there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the race begins.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even beneath the overcast sky, the atmosphere is crackling with energy. Sparks fly as the talented young racers bolt down the turf.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Work those legs! Focus on your lap time! Maintain your pace!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Stay aware of your surroundings! Come on! Don't give in! Run with all you've got!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The racer they're cheering for reaches the front of the pack early on and maintains a steady pace throughout.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And in the end…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hooray! She did it! She won!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Fantastic! She was amazing! That race played out perfectly for her!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Woo! She really pulled it off! This calls for a celebration!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash and Daiwa Scarlet are so overjoyed it's as if they won the race themselves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I sense an irreplaceable bond in the feelings they share for the young Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Thank you! However, those words would be better directed at our young victor.
choice_data_list: Looks like you've got yourself a new rival!
Looks like you've got yourself a new rival!
Let's arrange a big celebration for today.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Thank you! However, those words would be better directed at our young victor.
choice_data_list: Looks like you've got yourself a new rival!
Looks like you've got yourself a new rival!
Let's arrange a big celebration for today.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: So it seems. We'll have to stay on our toes once she has a trainer of her own.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I won't lose! Not to her, or to you, Flash!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I look forward to the day we can all race together on the track.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes, you're right. I'll have to cook up all of her favorite food.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'll help out, too! Oh, why don't we bake a cake together? I'm sure she'd love it!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Let's bake the most delicious treat we possibly can.
